title: Discern Your Intentions

promo.text: Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen HERE .

description: Gary explains that even spiritual insights can be twisted by the frightened parts of our personalities .

When our intentions stem from fear – from the need to control, impress, or be right – we misuse spiritual knowledge as a tool of manipulation. But when they come from love, our actions align with our soul’s purpose, leading to genuine connection and growth.

The solution lies in conscious awareness. By pausing before speaking or acting and asking ourselves, “What is my intention?” we begin to discern whether our energy comes from love or fear. This awareness is the key to transforming our relationships and creating authentic power.

This week, pause before you speak or act. Ask yourself: What is my intention? Notice whether it’s rooted in love or fear – in a desire to connect or to control. Each moment of awareness helps you build authentic power, transforming fear into love and aligning your personality with your soul.
